tools.name: provision_user
tools.description: Creates a new user account in PingOne AIC (ForgeRock Identity Cloud). Requires username, email, first_name, last_name, and password.

username.description: Login username for the new account

email.description: Email address of the new user

password.description: Initial password for the new account

tools.name: deprovision_user
tools.description: Permanently deletes a user account from PingOne AIC. Looks up the user by email and removes the account.

email.description: Email address of the user to delete

tools.name: update_user_status
tools.description: Enables or disables an existing user account in PingOne AIC. Looks up the user by email and sets the enabled flag.

email.description: Email address of the user to update

enabled.description: Set to true to enable the account, false to disable

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Lists or searches user accounts in PingOne AIC. Accepts an optional filter string (OpenIDM _queryFilter syntax). Returns up to 50 results.
